title: Discount or full price?
instruction: Children under 15 and people aged 65 and over get a discount.

items.why: 9 is less than 15, so the discount applies.
Watch the edge: 15 is not less than 15. Full price.
71 is more than 65, so the discount applies.
34 is not less than 15, and it isn't 65 or more either.
14 is less than 15, so the discount applies.
Watch the edge: “65 and over” includes exactly 65. The discount applies.
40 is not less than 15, and it isn't 65 or more either.
64 is still less than 65. Full price.

debrief: The condition “under 15 or 65 and over” decides exactly, even at the edge. A 15-year-old no longer gets the discount, a 65-year-old does. The edge is where conditions most often go wrong.
